verdict.rationale: There is no llms.txt: the probe got an HTTP 404 at docs.poly.app/llms.txt. Poly does ship agent-oriented material: every docs page has a raw Markdown version under docs.poly.app/raw/*.md, an official `poly-cli` agent skill teaches agents how to compose `poly` commands, and the Claude Code plugin 'teaches Claude how to use Poly'. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, documentation that explicitly presents the raw Markdown docs as an agent entry point, and independent corroboration of agents consuming these docs.
